investigated_initial_survivors: Added tests for --port, --help/-h, explicit C assignments, and unknown-file filtering.
Removed redundant pre-normalization checks; normalized-path validation already rejects backslashes/traversal, producing an equivalent initial mutation.
Added presentation tests for empty diagnostics, multiple-outline separators, and existing UTF-8 diagnostics mixed with other warnings.
limitations: Timeouts and unviable builds are separate from assertion-detected mutations.
Three Rust timeouts suppress initial publication and leave startup tests waiting.
The 16 JavaScript timeouts are in controller/update asynchronous state handling.
Identity macro expansion, dependency internals, native filesystem delivery, canvas painting and application glue are outside mutation scope.
